subject: Fix Deferred Reply Placeholders in Active Deferred Buffers (#3578)
reason: The fix only changes behaviour when addReplyDeferredLen/setDeferredReply run while the client's deferred reply buffer is active. That buffer is active only (a) inside the few core commands that call initDeferredReplyBuffer (SET..GET, GETEX, GETDEL, GETSET, LPOP/RPOP count, LMPOP, BITFIELD, HGETEX), all of which reply exclusively with known-length headers and never call addReplyDeferredLen, or (b) after a module blocks the client from inside a keyspace-notification callback, where the bug fires only if the module's reply callback builds a VALKEYMODULE_POSTPONED_LEN reply.
